email_body:
Dear Ariad team,

I'm writing to apply for the CRM / E-mail Marketing Specialist role with your retail client. With a background in digital marketing and hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web, I've developed a strong analytical mindset and a focus on measurable results. I've worked with CRM and marketing automation tools, set up A/B tests, and analysed campaign performance using Google Analytics and Search Console. I understand segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle marketing, and I'm eager to apply these skills to improve customer journeys and loyalty programme effectiveness.

In my current roles, I've managed CMS content, run technical audits, and used data to optimise websites for engagement and conversion. I'm comfortable with data analysis, identifying trends, and turning insights into actionable recommendations. I'm excited about the opportunity to join a retail-focused team and contribute to data-led, personalised e-mail communication.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my experience aligns with your needs.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Ariad team,

I'm excited to apply for the CRM / E-mail Marketing Specialist position with your retail client. With a digital marketing background that spans SEO, content, and web development, I've cultivated a data-driven approach to optimising customer experiences. While my recent roles have focused on organic growth, I've consistently worked with CRM and marketing automation tools, analysed campaign performance, and used insights to refine strategies—skills that directly translate to this role.

In my freelance and junior digital marketer positions, I've managed CMS content, run A/B tests, and tracked KPIs using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. I've also supported client websites in e-commerce and consultancy, where understanding customer journeys and segmentation was key to improving engagement. For example, at Episto, I optimised on-page SEO and content for client sites, monitoring results and adjusting tactics based on data. My technical background, including Python automation and experience with WordPress and Shopify, allows me to implement and assess experiments efficiently.

I'm particularly drawn to this role because it combines retail, loyalty, and personalised e-mail communication—areas where data can truly drive customer value. I understand the importance of lifecycle marketing and opt-in management, and I'm committed to using CRM data responsibly in line with GDPR. I'm eager to bring my analytical skills and commercial focus to your client's marketing team, helping to make campaigns more relevant and effective.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and enthusiasm can contribute to your client's success. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Experience with marketing automation and CRM tools, including HubSpot Content Marketing certification and hands-on work with CMS platforms like WordPress and Shopify.
• Proven ability to analyse campaign performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs, and to turn insights into optimisation recommendations.
• Skilled in setting up and assessing A/B tests and other experiments to improve engagement and conversion.
• Understanding of segmentation, personalisation, and lifecycle marketing, applied in e-commerce and consultancy projects.
• Commercial focus on customer experience, with a technical background that enables efficient implementation of data-led strategies.
